title: Arcade Appetite: Day 99
premise: A neon single-screen arcade game where a round character slides left and right to gobble falling food, gain weight, and survive until reaching Day 99 while avoiding instant-loss hazard drops.
interaction_model: Real-time horizontal pointer/touch movement on a full-screen canvas; the player tracks falling items and chooses lanes to catch food or dodge hazards.
objective: Collect enough food pickups to raise the day counter from 1 to 99 without touching any hazard item.
progression: Each food pickup increases the day count, raises weight, slightly enlarges the player avatar, and gradually increases the pressure of the run until either instant failure or a Day 99 victory celebration.
theme: Comedic arcade buffet survival with exaggerated appetite and hazard-dodging.
mood: Playful, flashy, tense, energetic, and meme-like.
likely_audience: Players who enjoy quick browser arcade games, casual reaction challenges, mobile-friendly dodge-and-collect play, and humorous food-themed presentation.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the core loop is catch food, avoid hazards, and survive to Day 99.
High confidence that the game is designed as a short-session arcade survival experience with mouse and touch support.
Moderate confidence that the increasing player size is intended as both progression feedback and escalating difficulty.
Moderate confidence that the hazard fiction is intentionally absurd rather than thematically strict.
recreation_prompt: Create a fast, full-screen browser arcade game called "Arcade Appetite: Day 99" in which the player controls a cute circular mascot near the bottom of the screen by sliding left and right with the mouse or a finger. Food items like burgers, pizza, fries, noodles, donuts, and other snack emojis should fall from the top, while a smaller set of clearly dangerous hazard emojis also falls among them. The goal is to survive the buffet gauntlet by catching food to raise a visible Day counter from 1 up to 99, while any collision with a hazard causes an instant game over. Each successful food pickup should also increase a Weight counter and slightly enlarge the player character, so progress feels satisfying but subtly makes dodging harder over time. Present the game as a neon purple arcade challenge with a full-screen canvas, floating decorative particles, a glowing HUD, and simple start, game-over, and victory overlays. Use juicy feedback such as screen shake, pickup sounds, combo reactions on streak milestones, a looping background track during play, and a celebratory particle explosion when Day 99 is reached. Keep the loop simple and readable: move horizontally, catch food, avoid hazards, survive longer as the pace intensifies, then either fail instantly on a bad catch or win with a flashy "Day 99" celebration.
